links.effect: The utility of HealthBench was limited by differences between the gold standard answers and those expected in specific UK hospitals.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of a real-world guideline-grounded clinical decision support tool ('Ask Eolas') using simulated clinical queries evaluated by clinicians and LLM-as-a-judge, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
